summary.ja: Wi-Fi・接続先を端末上で設定できるCardputer ADV用SSHクライアント。ホスト鍵の確認とターミナルのスクロールバックに対応。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: 基于经典 M5Stack Core 的双通道 PID 控制器，可配置传感器和输出，用于温湿度等控制实验。
summary.en: A dual-channel PID controller for classic M5Stack Core, with configurable sensors and outputs for experiments such as temperature and humidity control.
summary.ja: 従来のM5Stack Core向け2チャンネルPID制御器。温湿度などの制御実験用にセンサーと出力を設定できます。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: 在 StickC Plus2 上扫描附近的蓝牙和 Wi-Fi 设备，显示信号与持续出现情况，辅助观察无线环境。
summary.en: Scan nearby Bluetooth and Wi-Fi devices on StickC Plus2, displaying signal strength and recurring presence for radio-environment awareness.
summary.ja: StickC Plus2で周辺のBluetooth・Wi-Fiデバイスをスキャンし、信号強度や継続的な検出状況を表示する無線観測ツール。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: M5Stack 官方 StackChan 硬件支持库，配合 M5Unified 等依赖开发机器人外设交互；不是完整 AI 应用固件。
summary.en: Official hardware-support library for M5Stack StackChan, used with M5Unified and related libraries to develop peripheral interactions; not a complete AI application firmware.
summary.ja: M5Unifiedなどと組み合わせてロボットの周辺機器を開発する、M5Stack公式StackChanハードウェア対応ライブラリー。完全なAIアプリ用ファームウェアではありません。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: 在 Cardputer ADV 上直接编写和运行 Ruby、Python，内置文本编辑、日程、表格、绘画与小游戏。
summary.en: Write and run Ruby and Python directly on Cardputer ADV, with built-in writing, scheduling, spreadsheet, drawing, and game apps.
summary.ja: Cardputer ADV上でRuby・Pythonを直接編集・実行できる環境。文章、予定、表計算、描画、ミニゲーム用アプリを内蔵。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: 将 Core2、StickC 等设备的运动传感器数据和姿态四元数通过蓝牙串口发送到电脑，附带网页查看器。
summary.en: Send motion-sensor readings and orientation quaternions from Core2 and StickC devices to a computer over Bluetooth SPP, with a web viewer.
summary.ja: Core2・StickCなどのモーションセンサー値と姿勢クォータニオンをBluetooth SPPでPCに送り、Webビューアーで確認。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.

summary.zh: 用经典 M5Stack 的三个按键操作屏幕键盘的开发库，也支持摩斯输入和多种外接输入单元。
summary.en: A development library for a three-button onscreen keyboard on classic M5Stack, with Morse input and support for external input units.
summary.ja: 従来のM5Stackの3ボタンで操作する画面キーボード用ライブラリー。モールス入力と複数の外付け入力ユニットにも対応。

note: Short editorial summary based on the upstream README. Hardware support is documented upstream; no device testing was performed by esp32.sh.
